messages:
Dan P.: Quick heads-up — field lab on Wed 4/12 with AcmeInfra and CloudWave. We have an in-person cohost, a livestream, and 3 partner demo stations. Need final run-of-show and AV checklist by EOD tomorrow.
Maya R.: Got it. I'll push the draft run-of-show to the drive and ping speakers for timing.
Sophia L.: Venue walk scheduled Monday 10am with onsite AV. Can someone list hard requirements for each demo?
Kevin T.: Demo A (low-latency chat) needs 1x RTX A6000, wired ethernet, and HDMI out for stage screen. Demo B (batch embeddings) is CPU+SSD heavy — table power + surge. Demo C (on-prem private) needs isolated VLAN and an HSM connection test.
Arjun S.: For Demo C, confirm firewall rules: outbound to our private control plane on 443 only, and SSH locked to vendor jumpbox. I'll send the rule set.
Zoe H.: Swag: we have 200 t-shirts, 150 stickers, and 50 demo-kit cards. Shipping arrives Tuesday AM. Do we want a dedicated swag table or have hosts hand out?
Maya R.: Dedicated swag table is better — frees up hosts. Also plan for a small raffle after the final talk.
Dan P.: Livestream: we were quoted Vimeo Live via venue encoder. Need network test and stream key rotation plan. Who owns the stream key?
Kevin T.: I'll own network test. Can we get a local static IP from venue for the encoder so NAT doesn't break stream keys?
Sophia L.: I'll ask venue IT for static IP allocation during our block. Also request a secondary internet feed for failover.
Arjun S.: For fallback/demo resilience: if GPU nodes hit OOM, we fallback to quantized model hosted on Dedicated with lower QPS. Add an announcement slide for attendees in case we switch.
Maya R.: Good call — I'll add a slide and a sticky note for emcee with fallback script: 30s explanation + point to booth for deeper dive.
Zoe H.: Logistics note: swag pickup table needs 2 volunteers 30 mins before doors. Volunteers: @Maya R. and @Zoe H. confirmed.
Dan P.: Speaker check: @Arjun S., @Kevin T., and AcmeInfra rep need 15-min mic check at 3:00pm. Please be on time.
Kevin T.: Mic check confirmed. Also planning a short live demo rehearsal at 3:10 showing cold-start latency numbers: `p50=45ms p95=180ms` — will bring logs.
Sophia L.: AV checklist snippet for Monday walk (paste to venue):
```
- Stage mic x2 (lav + handheld)
- HDMI loopthrough tested at 4k/30hz
- Encoder with static IP & secondary internet
- Power strips x4 per demo table
- Ethernet drop to each demo table (1Gb)
- Onsite tech contact and spare laptop
```
Dan P.: Can someone add backup contact numbers? Venue tech + our on-call engineer + partner tech lead. Put them in the doc.
Arjun S.: Added partner tech lead (Maria from AcmeInfra) and our on-call (kevin.t@example.com, +1-415-555-0123).
Maya R.: Outreach: sending final email to registered attendees with schedule, speaker list, and livestream link (Vimeo) tomorrow AM. Draft ready for review.
Zoe H.: Shipping note: swag courier ETA Tue 9:30am. I'll confirm pickup window and put a sticker manifest on the case.
Dan P.: Ops items assigned: Kevin — network & encoder test; Sophia — venue IT static IP + AV; Arjun — firewall rules + fallback slide; Maya & Zoe — swag + run-of-show finalization. Everyone ok?
Kevin T.: OK from me.
Sophia L.: OK.
Arjun S.: OK.
Maya R.: OK.
Zoe H.: OK.
Dan P.: Great. If nothing else, we'll do the in-person walk at Mon 10am sharp. See you there. :thumbsup:
